name: io.github.saintmarksventures/bondseat
title: BondSeat
description: Snag hard-to-get Resy tables with automatic cancellation monitoring and scheduled release attempts.

environmentVariables.name: BONDSEAT_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Trusted HTTPS BondSeat REST API base. Defaults to production; override only for a configured environment.

environmentVariables.name: BONDSEAT_STATE_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to private persistent storage for one diner. Defaults to ~/.bondseat/connection.json. Use a separate file per diner and environment.
